title: Image Snapshot v1
description: Canonical image_snapshot v1 request envelope carrying a Base64-encoded JPEG frame and its caller-supplied identifiers. Readers are tolerant: unknown members are accepted and discarded so a later field addition stays non-breaking.

message_type.description: Constant discriminator identifying this envelope shape.

schema_version.description: Envelope schema version. Emitted as the string "1.0" by the v1 producer.

camera_id.description: Opaque caller-supplied camera identifier. No character set or length bound is applied.

timestamp.description: Capture time as epoch seconds. Integer, not an RFC 3339 string.

image_data.description: Standard-alphabet Base64 encoding of the raw JPEG payload. Padded, not URL-safe.

device_name.description: Opaque caller-supplied device identifier. No character set or length bound is applied.

location.description: Optional [latitude, longitude] pair. Contract-only: accepted by consumers for compatibility with other producers, and never emitted by this v1 producer.

metadata.description: Optional free-form caller-supplied metadata. Defaults to empty and is omitted rather than emitted as null when empty. Carries no sequence_number and no source_topic; this producer derives nothing from a transport topic.

correlation_id.description: Optional caller-supplied correlation identifier. Omitted rather than emitted as null when unset.

$comment: Recommended size bounds are 4 MiB maximum raw JPEG and 8 MiB maximum serialized envelope. Both are caller-configured defaults applied by the producer before and after normalization; neither is enforced by this schema, which declares no maxLength. additionalProperties is intentionally true (tolerant reader): strict rejection of unknown members belongs in tests, not in the runtime parser.
